name: VIFBENCH
description: VIFBENCH is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating instruction-following verifiers of large language models. It supports the assessment of frameworks that verify LLM outputs against instructions using neuro-symbolic methods, enabling reliable and interpretable analysis of instruction-following behavior.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for instruction-following verification that is useful in research on LLM reliability, but it is not yet broadly adopted as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Benchmark designed for evaluating neuro-symbolic instruction-following verification methods; includes data constructed via neuro-symbolic-guided synthesis.
